Hi everyone,

Thanks again for taking the final round with Nisha this morning. Before we lock scores in Greenhouse, quick ask: please add 2–3 concrete evidence snippets that justify your numerical score on the scorecard. We need these for an audit trail and to make a defensible debrief — especially on any 2s or 3s.

What I need by EOD:
- Numerical score (1-5) for each rubric axis (Technical, System Design, Collaboration, Product Sense).
- 2–3 short bullets of evidence per axis (quote or paraphrase the candidate).
- One clear hiring signal (e.g., ship example, debugging depth, tradeoff clarity) and one red flag (if any).

I attached Nisha's resume and a short guideline doc for wording (please skim). If you prefer, paste your notes into the Google doc linked below — I'll synthesize and post the final recommendation to the hiring packet.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1evidence-capture-guideline
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.io/candidate/ORBIT-1123

Thanks — I know this is a tight window.

Best,

Quick replies and pasted notes (I'll also attach my raw notes).
Scores I stamped: Technical 3, System Design 3, Collaboration 3, Product Sense 3.
Evidence (short):
- Technical: solved the whiteboard bug-fix but relied on an unfamiliar library suggestion; good debugging instincts but gaps on async scaling details (example: didn't call out backpressure strategy).
- System Design: outlined a reasonable partitioning but did not quantify load/latency tradeoffs; referenced a past design where they used SQS-like queues — useful signal, missing depth on consistency guarantees.
- Collaboration: deferred to PM on prioritization quickly, asked clarifying questions; evidence: asked about stakeholders' KPIs before proposing metrics.
- Product Sense: provided a user-first hypothesis but less crisp on success metrics.

Red flag: gave one anecdote of a shipped feature with limited measurement; not necessarily disqualifying but worth calling out.

Plan:
- I'll consolidate the notes into the GH packet and recommend move to an offer with level: Senior (IC3) but with a development plan around async systems/scale assumptions.
- If anyone strongly disagrees with that leveling or sees a blocker, flag here before 18:00 PST. Otherwise I'll submit the recommendation and close the loop with Priya.

Priya — we welcome any business concerns; timing-wise we can have an offer out by end of week if we lock.
